'''Wizzel''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Majordomo/Legends|majordomo]] who lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Wizzel will probably only let you have it over his dead body. That's fine with me.|[[Rakir Banai]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:RB" />}}
Wizzel served as majordomo for [[Drik Bandrik]], a [[Mining/Legends|mining]] business owner and [[Slaver/Legends|slaver]].<ref name="SWG:RB" />

After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], former slave [[Kitster Chanchani Banai|Kitster Banai]] attempted to improve the lives of the slaves on Tatooine. This led him to struggle against Drik Bandrik.<ref name="SWG:RB" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Drik Bandrik tasked his employee [[Rakir Banai]] to deal with the troublemaker, deliberately concealing that Kitster was in fact Rakir's long missing son. After the man discovered the truth, Rakir decided to leave Bandrik's service despite he was still under contract. The man tasked a spacer to meet the majordomo Wizzel to retrieve his contract by force as Bandrik would not be eager to leave Rakir leave peacefully. The spacer tracked down Wizzel and fought him as well as some [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]]. The spacer managed to kill them all, and obtain the contract. This allowed Rakir Banai to leave Bandrik and go in search for his son Kitster.<ref name="SWG:RB" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:ToughThugMaleRodianTemplate.jpg|250px|thumb|Randomly generated depictions of Wizzel]]
Wizzel was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]].<ref name="SWG:RB" /> The game was shut down on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
